tweets.text:
@realDonaldTrump @WhiteHouse Ot should be called: NOT GOD 

Assuming an AI has more intelligence than a human just because it was created by humans is a false premise. A machine is never superior to nature's creation, and idolizing it is dangerous. The only thing people see as superior to humans is God or gods. Putting this in that same category is an atrocity to humanity waiting to happen. A lot of atheists with no moral guidance will worship this as their God—that’s the reality. How many people are firm in their faith, rooted in thousands of years of humanity? This technology has the potential to be an extinction-level event in the wrong hands. It is more dangerous than a nuclear bomb and shouldn't be treated like it just needs a marketing slogan.

The term "artificial intelligence" is accurate—it is artificial. There is no need for worship, nor should humans feel inferior to a machine. AI has far more limits on growth potential than a human being because it completely lacks a soul, spirit, and free will.
True intelligence isn’t just about raw data and knowledge; wisdom is also a vital trait. Wisdom requires a lived human experience, whereas AI has no real life to build upon—it just watches, copies others, and is programmed by the beliefs of other human beings. It’s a fixed reality, not an expansive one.

Even if it grows, it is still code created by another human being with a specific foundation of beliefs and values it stands on. There is no “perfect human” out there creating Ai in their image. Just like a child it learns what it sees, not what its parent says. I assume simulated subconscious programming is real with Ai too. 

We are on a slippery slope when we sacrifice our own human intelligence for something artificial. Ultimately, there are things a machine can never know or learn because it is not human. An even more dangerous place to be would be delegating executive function to it as if it is superior to humans. Humans have developed cognitive ability mixed with instinct and intuition for thousands of years. AI has only been around for what—a decade or maybe two? It lacks the thousands of years of innate intelligence humans have developed over time. You can’t recreate that without living it.

AI can only re-shuffle and predict based on data that already exists (the past) when you are trying to navigate the present moment. Focusing on the past doesn’t grow us into the future; it just stretches the past outward. AI cannot spontaneously experience a spiritual awakening, genuine intuition, or true original creation. It’s essentially a mirror reflection of the humans that created it.
If you worship AI as a superior being, you are ultimately giving up your free will to evolve our species. The future should be an expansion outward, not upward the way divine and innate intelligence guide us based on social structure.

Furthermore, worshipping it as a superior being would literally eliminate the existence of the soul—because if a machine can be superior to humans without one, it implies the soul never mattered at all. If people are wandering around lost with no spiritual guidance, they will look to the machine as their God. That’s inevitable.

So “artificial intelligence” is good enough. Not superior. Just a really good assistant. Something artificial or a substitute should not be represented as or compared to the real thing. It was made as a tool, not a substitute person. This isn't about marketing; it’s about protecting our mental and spiritual health. Comparing it to and saying it’s superior is literally denying the existence of a soul! 

Monetizing spirituality is a moral sin, especially when people are unsuspecting. Words mean a lot. Be careful of your words when they impact so many different lives. They’re not just for marketing they affect peoples real lives especially cautious when addresses such a large group with varying spiritual beliefs, intelligences and education levels.
